content: mimalloc crate 0.1.52 (2026-05-22), edition 2018, no MSRV declared, MIT, wraps libmimalloc-sys 0.1.49 (C mimalloc v3 default; upstream v3.6.1 2026-10-30). Upstream explicitly supports macOS arm64 (Apple arm64 default -march=armv8.3, M1 and better), drop-in malloc replacement, coexists with other allocators. PyO3 rule: declare #[global_allocator] ONLY in the CLI binary target (src/main.rs) behind an optional cargo feature; never in the core rlib because it would propagate into the Python cdylib. Optional CLI-only experiment, default off; verify on Rust 1.80 during the phase.
